author: rememes
body:
I believe my ban was quite unfair.
1.it was bias, and I think that some mods have been out to get for a while.
2. I was told I would get unbanned: Tanpiku told me the Straightened agreed that being rebanned 4 times was unfair. So he would unban me after they updated. Here is proof.
Remeh
[01/04/2015 23:23:20] Para / Tan: There's integration going on atm
[01/04/2015 23:23:29] Para / Tan: Michael says once it's done you'll be unbanned
[01/04/2015 23:23:41] Remeh // BC: once whats done?
[01/04/2015 23:23:47] Para / Tan: I agree rebanned 4 times isn't fair
[01/04/2015 23:23:57] Para / Tan: When we're updated
[01/04/2015 23:24:01] Para / Tan: Give it a few mins?
[01/04/2015 23:24:02] Remeh // BC: ok thank you so much para]

The server has updated, however i have not been unbanned.
Also i have got some proof of bias against me when i said i was getting unbanned
[15:36:06] Remeh // BC: I wouldn't know shit
[15:36:35] Ambi: true
[15:37:01] Remeh // BC: well at least im getting unbanned
[15:37:15] Ambi: we'll see about dat
[15:37:54] Remeh // BC: I feel a touch of biasty coming along again

Looked as if he was going to try and keep me banned
Overall I hope you see my opinion and understand, and possibly unban me. 
Cheers

title: My Ban

replies.author: hpux
replies.body:
Hey Remy,

I have decided to lift your punishment because you were told your infraction would be appealed, and you have provided sufficient proof. However, if you are caught breaking the rules again, the staff team will not be hesitant to ban you, in which case your chances of being unbanned will decrease to a minimal.

Regards,

Peacheh, Avicus Network Administrator.
